idea-plugin.name: xtsc
idea-plugin.description:
TypeScript code insight backed by xtsc — the TypeScript scanner, parser, binder, type checker, transformer and emitter rewritten from scratch in Kotlin.

The compiler runs inside the IDE process. There is no Node.js runtime, no tsserver child process, and no language server protocol between the editor and the type checker — the IDE asks the compiler for hover, completion, navigation and diagnostics through a direct function call, against unsaved editor buffers.

Planned capabilities:

  • Whole-program type checking driven by tsconfig.json
  • Hover, go to definition, find usages, completion and signature help
  • Rename that is re-checked before it is applied
  • Diagnostics matching those reported by tsc

This plugin is in early development and does not implement the above yet. Follow its progress in the plugin repository, and read about the compiler behind it in the xtsc repository.
